methods.label: Group neighboring terms
methods.explanation:
Each positive term is \(2\) greater than the subtracted term immediately after it. Group those neighboring terms:
\[
(100-98)+(96-94)+\cdots+(4-2).
\]
The expression contains every positive even number from \(2\) through \(100\), so it has \(100\div2=50\) terms. These make \(50\div2=25\) pairs, with every term used exactly once.

Each pair equals \(2\), so the value is \(25\cdot2=50\), choice C.
